# Ananya Electrical Solutions
> Government-licensed Super Grade electrical contractor headquartered in Sahakarnagar, Bengaluru, providing turnkey 11kV–110kV substations, HT/LT panels, BESCOM & CEIG approvals, industrial wiring, and commercial rooftop solar EPC across Karnataka.

## Core Engineering Services
- [Electrical Contracting Services](https://ananyaelectricalsolutions.com/services): Turnkey electrical installation, SLD design, HT/LT distribution panels, testing and 24/7 AMC.
- [HT/LT Electrical Works](https://ananyaelectricalsolutions.com/ht-lt-electrical-works): 11kV–110kV substations, power transformers, VCB switchgear, and CEIG approvals.
- [Solar Power Solutions](https://ananyaelectricalsolutions.com/solar-power-solutions): Commercial, industrial, and residential rooftop solar EPC with BESCOM net metering.
- [Executed Projects Portfolio](https://ananyaelectricalsolutions.com/projects-gallery): Verified portfolio of commissioned substations, industrial plants, and rooftop solar installations across Karnataka.
